mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month compresses discount rates for equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precede reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances where UNRATE > 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) over the prior two months indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which typically results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 250), a rising CPI index signals impending Federal Reserve tightening, which compresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 250 and CPIAUCSL rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals strengthening labor market conditions, which typically supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances where PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production level below 105.0 (index, 2017=100) indicates a contraction in manufacturing and industrial activity, which typically precedes reduced corporate profits and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances where INDPRO < 105.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and monthly housing starts (HOUST) over the prior six months and two months, respectively, indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, which typically results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 40% of instances where both GDPC1 and HOUST decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong consumer demand regime (RSAFS > 500000), a rising retail sales index (RSAFS increasing from the prior month) signals robust consumer spending, which typically supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in < 40% of instances where RSAFS > 500000 and RSAFS rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
